jobs.description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions support health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
The position
As an Application Engineer at Cambio, you will work with third-line technical support and troubleshooting of our e-health solutions. You will be part of our Application Management team, acting as a technical link between our customers and our development organization.
The role offers a broad technical scope, where you will troubleshoot Java-based applications, SQL databases, operating systems, networks and related infrastructure. You will manage technical support cases, analyze logs and other technical information, and participate in technical activities and changes in customer environments.
You will work with solutions used in large installations with thousands of concurrent users, where availability, performance and reliability are essential. You will take ownership of your own technical cases while working closely with experienced Application Engineers and other technical teams when solving more complex issues. The role also involves daily customer contact, primarily through our ticketing system, as well as through video meetings when needed. 
Your responsibilities include:
Managing and troubleshooting technical support cases across applications and customer environments.

Analyzing logs, SQL databases and other technical information to identify and resolve issues.

Troubleshooting Java-based applications and related infrastructure.

Collaborating with customers and technical teams to resolve more complex issues and support changes in customer environments.

Documenting solutions and sharing knowledge within the team.

We offer:

An opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies and varied technical challenges, while continuing to develop your expertise across applications, databases and infrastructure.

Work in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing is a natural part of the day-to-day work and where you can both contribute your expertise and learn from others.

Work with business-critical e-health solutions used by healthcare professionals every day, where availability, performance and reliability really matter.

 About you
You have a broad technical interest and enjoy understanding how applications, databases and infrastructure work together. You enjoy troubleshooting and problem-solving and are curious to get to the root of technical issues.
You take ownership of your work while also valuing collaboration and knowledge sharing. You communicate comfortably with both customers and colleagues and are motivated to continue developing your technical expertise.
At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values.

Requirements 

Experience from a technical IT role, such as application support, system administration, IT operations or software development.

Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language.

Working knowledge of Windows and/or Linux environments.

Experience troubleshooting technical issues in applications or IT environments.

Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

It's a bonus if you have experience with

Microsoft SQL Server and Java or Java-based applications.

Windows Server and/or Linux system administration.

Application monitoring and log analysis.

Networks, integrations or container-based infrastructure.

Customer support or ticketing systems.

Additional information:
Place of employment: Linköping
Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)
Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period
Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.
We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.
We look forward to receiving your application!

The opportunity
Hitachi Energy is seeking Project Managers – Supply Chain for its Sweden locations. This is a great opportunity to apply your passion for project management to manage million-dollar projects! 
This is an individual contributor role, responsible for SCM (Supply Chain Management) in the Project, reporting to the Regional Supply Chain Manager while supporting the project director. 
If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing the SCM scope of large projects close to the end customer. 
This is a hybrid position and is based in Ludvika or Västerås Hitachi Energy office. 
We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join! 
How you’ll make an impact
In this role you will be project manager within the HVDC SCM project. 
You will be part of the HVDC Project Core team for the projects you manage. 
In this role, you will coordinate across multiple global regions with engineers, controllers, project planners, logisticians, quality professionals, buyers, and suppliers to ensure that equipment is procured and delivered on time, within budget, and with the right quality. 
You will be responsible for ensuring that all key personnel within the project, global supply chain, the HVDC organization, and the client are aware of any risks to and opportunities within project supply chain

Your background
Degree in business, operations, engineering with preferably 5+ years relevant work experience.
Demonstrated ability to manage the supply chain management needs of multi-million dollar projects. 
Strong organizational and planning skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities & proactively address business demands in a fast-paced environment. 
Ability to prioritize and allocate resources to align with department and company goals. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to create strong working relationships. 
Preferred: CPSM or PMP certifications, Lean Six Sigma, SAP Experience, Documentation Management Systems, Power BI and proficiency with Microsoft Office. 

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing wellbeing, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grows together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurance. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit yours today. ​
All questions regarding recruitment process can be directed to Talent Partner Eva Schölin, eva.scholin@hitachienergy.com. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Nawzad Rashi, +46 107-38 70 46; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107 38 70 43; Unionen: Karin Ulvemark, +46 107-38 51 42.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to develop, maintain and improve the data infrastructure and backend services supporting our RE:Flex platform.
The role involves working with real-time IoT data, cloud infrastructure, databases and data pipelines to ensure reliable data collection, processing, storage and delivery.
You will work closely with backend developers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers and other teams across the business, operations and finance. Alongside hands-on development, you will contribute to technical improvements, code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge sharing.
Key Responsibilities
Data Engineering and Pipelines
Develop and maintain Python-based services for collecting and processing data from connected energy devices, including battery systems and meters.
Build and improve real-time and batch data pipelines using MQTT, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and other messaging technologies.
Integrate data from external APIs, energy market platforms and other relevant data sources.
Implement data validation, error handling, retry mechanisms and safe backfilling to improve data quality and reliability.
Develop and maintain data processing workflows, including aggregation and transformation of time-series data.

Backend Development and Cloud Infrastructure
Develop and maintain backend APIs and services for accessing real-time and historical platform data.
Work with databases and storage solutions such as BigQuery, TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, depending on application requirements.
Develop, deploy and maintain containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Contribute to cloud infrastructure improvements, primarily within Google Cloud Platform.
Support integrations between data services, backend applications and other platform components.

Data Quality, Monitoring and Reliability
Monitor data pipelines, database performance and service reliability using tools such as Grafana and cloud monitoring services.
Investigate data inconsistencies, missing records, processing failures and other production issues.
Improve data processing performance, scalability and operational stability.
Implement appropriate data quality checks, logging, monitoring and alerting.
Support incident investigation, troubleshooting and implementation of technical fixes.

Energy Market and Business Data
Support data processing and integration for energy market operations, including market prices, schedules, measurements and settlement information.
Develop and maintain data workflows used for operational reporting, revenue calculations and customer invoicing.
Work with market operations, finance and other business teams to understand data requirements and resolve discrepancies.
Help ensure data consistency and traceability across relevant systems and integrations.

Technical Collaboration and Documentation
Participate in technical planning, architecture discussions and code reviews.
Coordinate with backend, DevOps, machine learning and other engineering teams on data-related implementations.
Support onboarding and knowledge sharing with other engineers.
Maintain technical documentation, data flow descriptions and operational procedures.
Contribute to continuous improvements in development practices, deployment processes and platform reliability.

Required Qualifications
Relevant education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, backend development or a related software engineering role.
Strong programming skills in Python and good knowledge of SQL.
Experience developing data pipelines, backend services and REST APIs.
Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases and cloud-based data processing.
Familiarity with messaging systems, streaming data or asynchronous processing.
Practical experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure.
Understanding of software development practices, version control, testing and debugging.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.
Professional working proficiency in English.

Meriting Experience
Google Cloud Platform, particularly Pub/Sub, BigQuery and Cloud Storage.
MQTT, IoT telemetry or real-time data processing.
TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other time-series and NoSQL databases.
Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Dagster, Airflow or similar data orchestration tools.
Monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.
Experience with data reconciliation, reporting or invoicing integrations.
Knowledge of battery energy storage systems, energy flexibility services or Nordic electricity markets.
Experience supporting technical onboarding, documentation or cross-team coordination.

What We Offer
The opportunity to contribute to Sweden's energy transition through real-world energy technology solutions.
Hands-on experience working with real-time data, cloud infrastructure and distributed energy systems.
A collaborative engineering environment with opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and platform improvements.
The opportunity to work across data engineering, backend development and energy market applications.

jobs.occupation: Post-doc in Energy Engineering with focus on Brayton Heat Pump systems
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Engineering Sciences brings together a large part of the University’s Bachelor of Science in Engineering and Master of Science in Engineering programmes in fields such as energy engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, building engineering, environmental engineering and industrial systems. The department conducts internationally recognised research focusing on future energy and industrial systems. Collaboration with industry and society is central to developing sustainable, resource-efficient and competitive solutions for the society of tomorrow.
Employment information
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
Period of employment/Start date: As soon as possible or as agreed. 
Scope: Full time
Number of positions: 2
Closing date for application: 1st of January 2027
Campus location: Västerås
School: Teknikvetenskap
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
The research within the FlexInd-BHP project focuses on the fundamental understanding, modelling, and optimisation of Brayton-based heat pump and thermal energy storage systems, including the development of forecasting models, model predictive control, and the integration of artificial intelligence. The postdoctoral researchers will develop physics-based and data-driven methods in which machine learning is combined with advanced physical models to enable faster simulations, control strategies, and optimisation analyses with high accuracy.
The successful candidates are expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and within the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues, publication of results in peer-reviewed scientific journals as well as project reporting events.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD degree in Energy Engineering.
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
The successful applicant is required to have a PhD degree in engineering or a related field with a strong focus on gas turbine technology, Brayton heat pumps, thermal energy storage, or similar areas.
A solid documented foundation in the physics and dynamics of said energy systems is essential. Experience is expected also in machine learning, particularly its application in advanced control and optimization.
The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.)
The candidate shall demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups.
Proficiency in programming languages and tools for data processing and analysis is required.
Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.   
Assessment criteria
This is an abridged version of the job advertisement. To view the full advertisement, including the assessment criteria, please visit:
https://www.mdu.se/om-mdu/jobba-med-oss/lediga-jobb

About Sunmedic
Sunmedic is a forward-thinking medical device company dedicated to delivering innovative, safe, and effective products for patients. We’re seeking a results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team and help grow our brand, generate demand, and support product launches across markets. This role offers the opportunity to shape go-to-market strategies, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and play a pivotal role in bringing life-saving devices to patients.
 
What you’ll do
Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels to drive product awareness and demand.
Collaborate with Product manager, Sales, Regulatory, and Medical Affairs to create compelling messaging, positioning, and value propositions for target segments.
Manage content creation (website, blogs, case studies, brochures, social media) and lifecycle activities aligned with product launches and lifecycle management.
Plan and optimize digital marketing efforts (SEO/SEM, social media, analytics) to achieve lead generation and pipeline goals.
Analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive landscape to inform strategy and tactics.
Support events, webinars, and trade shows; coordinate collateral and speaker opportunities.
Measure, report, and optimize campaign performance with clear KPI dashboards.

Ansvara för marknadsstrategi: ta fram och driva marknadsstrategi och handlingsplan för tillväxt, i linje med bolagets mål 
Marknadsplan och genomförande: planera, prioritera och följa upp aktiviteter (kanalstrategi, kampanjer, lanseringar) 
Marketing av nya sårvårdsprodukter: ta huvudansvar för planering och genomförande av marknadsaktiviteter kopplade till nya produkter (go-to-market, lanseringsplaner, kampanjer och material) 
Kommersiell utveckling: bidra till mål för pipeline/leadsgenerering, försäljningstillväxt och ökad marknadsandel (tillsammans med distributörer) 
Segment och målgrupper: utveckla segmentering och säkerställa att budskap och erbjudanden matchar behov hos relevanta målgrupper 
Varumärke och positionering: säkra att varumärkesplattform och kommunikation är konsekvent och tydlig 
Ensure regulatory and compliance: Ensure brand consistency and adherence to regulatory/compliance considerations in marketing materials.
Marknadskunskap och analys: följa marknadsdata, kundinsikter och konkurrensläge samt omsätta detta i förbättringar 
Budget och KPI:er: ansvara för marknadsbudget samt rapportera KPI:er och resultat (ROI, leadflöden, konvertering, aktiviteter som ger effekt) 
Samordning internt: nära samarbete med produktion, kvalitet/QA, logistik, produktutveckling och ledning för att säkerställa att marknadens planer är genomförbara och i rätt kvalitet 

Who you are
A creative, data-driven marketer with a growth mindset and a collaborative approach.
Strong storyteller who can translate complex medical device value into clear, compelling messaging.
Results-oriented with excellent project management and prioritization skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and cross-functional teams.
Clear communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 

What you have
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
Experience: >2 years of marketing experience, preferably in medical devices or healthcare; B2B experience a plus.
Digital skills: Proficiency with marketing automation (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo), CRM (e.g., Salesforce), Google Analytics, SEO/SEM, and social media management.
Language: Proficiency in English (written and spoken); additional languages a plus.

Skills:
 Strong written and verbal communication; compelling content creation.
 Ability to analyze data, derive insights, and translate into action.
 Project management, budgeting, and vendor coordination abilities.
 Design sense for basic visuals or familiarity with design tools is a plus.
 Knowledge of regulatory considerations for medical devices in marketing materials is a    plus.

Nice-to-have
Experience supporting product launches or lifecycle marketing in a regulated industry.
Experience with events, webinars, and field marketing.
Knowledge of ISO 13485-related processes or quality systems awareness.

 
What we offer
Competitive salary and benefits.
Flexible work arrangements and a collaborative, innovative culture.
Opportunities for professional growth and meaningful impact in the medical device field.

 
How to apply
Share your resume/CV and a brief cover letter outlining your marketing experience and why you’re interested in Sunmedic to abbas.karladani@sunmedic.se. If you’d like, include links to notable campaigns, case studies, or programs you’ve led.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
We are looking for a Mobility Operations Specialist with a strong focus on Swedish immigration and inbound mobility to support employees relocating to Sweden. This role is critical in ensuring compliance with Swedish immigration regulations and delivering a smooth, well-managed experience for assignees moving into the country. 
You will act as a key point of contact for inbound assignees, internal stakeholders, and external providers, with Swedish immigration expertise being a core requirement for the role. 
Key responsibilities 
Manage end-to-end inbound mobility cases to Sweden, with a primary focus on immigration 
Act as the subject matter expert on Swedish immigration processes, including work permits, residence permits, extensions, and family applications 
Coordinate closely with immigration providers, authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant case handling 
Advise HR and the business on immigration timelines, risks, and compliance requirements 
Support assignment initiation activities such as cost estimates, documentation, assignment letters, and approvals 
Ensure ongoing compliance with Swedish immigration, tax, and social security requirements for inbound assignees 
Be the main point of contact for assignees, providing clear guidance and support throughout the relocation process 
Contribute to continuous improvement of inbound mobility and immigration processes and policies 

 
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
You will collaborate with HR teams, business leaders, external immigration providers, and Swedish authorities to ensure a seamless relocation experience for inbound employees. 
 
WHO YOU ARE 
We are looking for people with… 
Proven experience in global mobility or immigration, with a strong focus on Sweden 
Solid knowledge of Swedish immigration legislation and processes  
Experience managing inbound employee populations and working with immigration vendors 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills 
Fluent in English; Swedish is highly desirable 
Experience with mobility or immigration case management systems is a plus 
Relevant education within HR, Business Administration, International Relations or a related field.

And people who are… 
Service-minded and proactive 
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others 
Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases 

 
WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 
An example of our benefits:     
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).      
H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.      
With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and international mobility. 

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 
This is a full time permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your application today. We will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews continuously, so don’t wait to apply! 
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

At CCRM Nordic, we're advancing innovative cell and gene therapies from development to clinical and commercial manufacturing. We're now looking for a Validation Engineer to join our growing team and support the establishment and operation of our GMP manufacturing facilities.
The role
In this role, you'll contribute to the qualification and validation of equipment, systems and facilities used in the development and manufacturing of advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs). Working closely with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Quality Control and external suppliers, you'll help ensure that equipment and processes are installed, tested and documented according to regulatory and quality requirements.
This role offers an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with structured documentation in a highly regulated and innovative environment.
Key responsibilitiesEquipment Qualification & Validation
You will support qualification and validation activities for laboratory, manufacturing and QC equipment used in GMP-regulated operations. This includes executing qualification protocols, performing hands-on testing, documenting results and ensuring that equipment is fit for its intended use and compliant with quality requirements.
Documentation & Compliance
You will prepare, review and maintain qualification and validation documentation, including protocols, reports and supporting records. You will also review supplier documentation, equipment manuals, specifications and certificates, ensuring documentation is complete, accurate and maintained within CCRM Nordic Quality Management System (QMS).
Risk Management & Continuous Improvement
As part of qualification activities, you will contribute to risk assessments, deviation investigations and corrective actions as required. You will also support periodic requalification activities and participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to equipment lifecycle management and validation processes.
Cross-functional Collaboration
You will work closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Manufacturing and MSAT, as well as external suppliers and equipment vendors. Together, you will support equipment implementation, facility expansion projects and the continued development of CCRM Nordic's GMP operations.
What we're looking for
B.Sc. in Engineering, Biotechnology, Biomedicine, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences or a related field. Equivalent experience may also be considered.

Recent graduate or up to 2 years of relevant experience within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices or another technical environment.

Hands-on experience working with laboratory, analytical or process equipment through studies, thesis work, internships or industry experience.

Comfortable working in a structured environment and documenting work accurately.

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across functions.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications
Additional experience in one or more of the following areas is considered advantageous:

Understanding of GMP principles, ISO 13485 and regulated environments.

Knowledge of equipment qualification and validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), including work with risk assessment, user requirements, deviations and CAPAs.

Experience working with controlled documentation or Quality Management Systems.

Experience working in cleanroom or manufacturing environments.

The person
We're looking for a curious and motivated individual who is eager to develop their expertise within validation and qualification in a GMP-regulated industry environment.
You are detail-oriented, organized and comfortable balancing documentation with practical, hands-on activities. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different functions, thrive in a team environment and communicate effectively with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
Most importantly, you're motivated by solving technical challenges, continuously learning and contributing to the development of innovative therapies that have the potential to improve patients' lives.
Why join CCRM Nordic?
At CCRM Nordic, you'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of cell and gene therapy development and manufacturing alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about making a difference.
You'll be part of a collaborative and purpose-driven organization where quality, innovation and teamwork are central to everything we do. As our facilities and capabilities continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to develop your expertise, take on increasing responsibility and contribute to bringing innovative therapies closer to patients.

An international organisation is seeking an Interim Head of Purchasing to assess and develop its global purchasing function while leading the team. The assignment covers all entities and locations, with recommendations that balance group-wide priorities with local business needs, supplier markets and applicable requirements.
Key responsibilities

Assess the current function. Review spend, responsibilities, capabilities, processes, systems and stakeholder needs. Establish a baseline and prioritise opportunities to improve commercial outcomes, efficiency and support for the business.

Set priorities for AI adoption. Identify and prioritise AI use cases, define business and data requirements, and specify human oversight, expected benefits and acceptance criteria. Lead adoption within Purchasing, with technical support from a shared AI specialist.

Review purchasing and partnership ownership. Assess how hardware, software, other purchasing categories and consultant procurement should be organised. Evaluate how partnerships are managed across business units and recommend how ownership, coordination and performance should be tracked.

Design and start implementing the global operating model. Define Purchasing’s mandate, structure, governance and resource needs. Clarify which activities should be managed globally or locally and how Purchasing will work with business units and corporate functions. Develop a phased plan and begin implementing agreed priorities.

Proven ability to design and implement global procurement operating models, governance structures and working practices.

Extensive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation and procurement governance.

Experience assessing procurement functions, analysing spend, reviewing organisational capabilities and making recommendations to executive leadership.

Experience managing and developing procurement teams, with direct line management responsibility and experience leading teams through change.

Experience working with global stakeholders across Finance, HR, IT and business units, as well as with external suppliers.

Experience defining business requirements, processes, governance and adoption plans for digital procurement solutions.

Experience identifying, prioritising and implementing AI and automation use cases in procurement or supply chain.

Ability to turn business needs into AI requirements, business cases and adoption roadmaps with measurable outcomes.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership teams.

Fluency in written and spoken English.

Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions support health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.
The position
As a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer at Cambio, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and developing secure and scalable network solutions across complex environments. Your expertise in network and infrastructure design will be important as we continue to evolve our WAN, LAN, segmentation and network security capabilities.
A key part of the role will also be to develop how we work with network automation. We want to move towards more automated, repeatable and version-controlled ways of managing our network infrastructure, applying a GitOps mindset where relevant.
You will work closely with colleagues across IT Operations, internal stakeholders, customers and external partners. In addition to hands-on technical work, you will act as a technical advisor, helping translate different needs and requirements into robust and sustainable network solutions.
Your responsibilities include:
Designing and implementing secure, scalable and highly available network solutions.

Driving solution design and development of WAN, LAN, WLAN, segmentation and network security.

Developing network automation and contributing to a more GitOps-oriented way of managing network infrastructure.

Acting as a technical advisor within networking and network security to internal stakeholders, customers and partners.

Contributing network expertise to larger projects, from early design through implementation and operations.

Evaluating technologies and solutions to improve reliability, efficiency and security.

Supporting day-to-day network operations, troubleshooting and configuration when needed. 

We offer:

Work hands-on with large and complex network environments, taking an important role in projects where networking is a central part of the solution.

Take an active role in designing and building our future network infrastructure, with the opportunity to develop how we work with automation and GitOps.

Work closely with experienced network specialists, customers and technology partners, giving you the opportunity to both contribute your expertise and continue developing your own.

Use your network expertise in solutions that support healthcare, where secure and reliable infrastructure has a real impact on society. 

About you
You are an experienced network professional who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to see the bigger picture. You enjoy discussing and challenging technical solutions and are confident in sharing your perspective, while remaining curious and open to other approaches. You communicate comfortably with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working together to find the best solution.
At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care, and Together—values we believe are important to both our work and our people. It’s important to us that you recognize and identify with these values. 
Requirements 

Experience in designing and implementing network infrastructure within large and complex environments, including solution design.

Deep knowledge of WAN, LAN, WLAN, network segmentation and network security.

Experience with network automation and an interest in developing more automated ways of working.

Professional proficiency in Swedish and English.

It's a bonus if you have

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps methodologies, preferably applied to network infrastructure.

Experience with network monitoring platforms and tools.

Relevant certifications within networking or infrastructure.

Experience with networks or infrastructure within healthcare or other complex, security-critical environments.

Are you a front-end developer who wants to build user interfaces that bring real-world industrial hardware to life – from forklifts in warehouses to charging systems in ports? Do you care about the experience people have when they use your software, and like being involved in the full journey from problem definition to production? Then we have a great opportunity for you.
We make electrification of the industry a reality.
Micropower is an international company headquartered in Växjö, Sweden. With strong in-house expertise, we develop and produce efficient, intelligent lithium-ion batteries, charging systems, and power converters. We operate in Sweden, the USA, Germany, Finland, Italy.
What you'll do 
In this role you design and build interactive, user-friendly interfaces in React that help our customers monitor, understand and manage their energy fleets. You turn complex data from batteries and chargers into clear, actionable views, and work closely with the rest of the team on the APIs that power them. You own features end-to-end and collaborate across functions with product, sales and support to make sure what we build solves real problems.
You will join a small, product-driven team developing open, secure solutions for the energy industry. With open source at the core of everything we build, we prioritise transparency, reusability, integrity and adherence to open standards. As we are a small team, you will also support other areas which gives you a great opportunity to widen your competence.
The GET team builds and operates the GET Fleet Management System – a containerised cloud and mobile platform that connects to physical energy hardware. The team works closely with Product, Sales and Service to drive the development of open-source energy solutions.
The position is based in Växjö and you will report to Global Software Manager. 
What you’ll get 
A key role in a fast-growing, innovative company where your creativity and ideas have a real impact.  
A dynamic, development-driven environment with great opportunities for professional growth.  
Collaboration across functions, in an international environment. 
Work with cutting-edge technology in a culture that values initiative, collaboration, and continuous learning.  

Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/IT or equivalent demonstrated work experience
Around 3–6 years of experience building web applications in a production environment
Strong knowledge of React and modern front-end tools (hooks, state management, bundlers)
Experience integrating front-ends with APIs and handling real-time or data-heavy views
A good eye for usability and user experience
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

We also value experience wth:  
Python and/or Go
MongoDB or other document databases
familiarity with containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
data visualisation or dashboard-style applications

Who you are
You are genuinely interested in programming, high-quality results, and maintainable code. Driven and curious, you take ownership of your work from problem to production. You enjoy working in a small, autonomous team and care about the experience your work creates for the end user. Transparency in communication with colleagues across functions – including people outside engineering – is a given for you, and you value open standards and reusable solutions. Change motivates you and you welcome challenges. You solve problems by communicating with others, driving your own development and delivering good results.
Our core principles of presence and responsibility guide us as we progress with dedication and sincerity.  At Micropower we fuel people to power growth.
Join us in the exciting journey to a more sustainable future!
Application
